# MenuSub

A nested menu in a `Menu`: an item that opens more items beside it, on hover, click or the arrow key. On a phone it is a sheet over its menu, with a Back item at its top.

```tsx
import { MenuSub } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/menu/menu";
```

## Example

```tsx
<MenuSub label="Share">
  <MenuItem onClick={copyLink}>Copy link</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem href={mailto}>Email</MenuItem>
</MenuSub>
```

## Use instead when

- Use `MenuGroup` instead when the items fit in the menu under a label: nested menus are harder to reach.

## Props

Type: `MenuSubProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backLabel` | `string` | `"Back"` | The label of the item at the top of the submenu on a phone, where the submenu is a sheet over its menu, that goes back to it. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The submenu's items. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | The item cannot open the submenu. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | The text of the item that opens the submenu. |
